title: Orbinity
tagline: Tap to fling the comet from planet to planet

fr.tagline: Une comète en orbite. Tape pour couper la gravité et la projeter vers la planète suivante.

en.tagline: A comet in orbit. Tap to snap gravity and fling it toward the next planet.

description: A comet orbits a mini planet, dust tail trailing. Tap to snap gravity and fling it along the tangent — the planet explodes, a new one spawns, and the next well catches you. Walls bounce and break the chain.
